economic_duplicate_candidates.reason: Unique trade_id values and repeated block fills make automatic collapse unsafe; baseline preserves all unique trade IDs.

caveats: BUY/SELL is transaction side and does not prove opening or closing.
complex_order_id is absent for all visible rows; multileg linkage is inferred from timestamps, sizes, strikes and side geometry.

The raw timezone field says America/New_York, but clock values are inconsistent with a normal SPX session and appear closer to Cyprus local time; raw timestamps are therefore kept offset-unresolved inside structures.
Visible tape is premium-filtered at $50k+ and is not the full market position.
Premium strings are rounded to K/M units; structure cash economics should prefer trade_price x contracts x multiplier where exact debit/credit is required.
